name: list-constant-negative-test-9d4e6d6a8a/list_constant_negative-e.bal
reason: Most assertions concern rejection of invalid list constants, element types, lengths, numeric ranges and nonconstant expressions within supported constructs. However, TUPLE_6 includes table<int>, requiring table type constraint validation; table types and their constraint behavior are not covered by the subset's positive feature list. This makes the whole case feature-scoped.
unsupported_constructs: Table type descriptor table<int> and its invalid row-type constraint in TUPLE_6
test_design_notes: Negative code alone does not make a case unsupported; the other constant/list rejection checks fall within the listed features.
int:Signed8 is explicitly supported by the lang.int allowlist.
